result:
I've fixed F-DG1-134: a module file named `.mts`, `.cts`, `.mjs`, `.cjs`, `.js` or `.jsx` is now checked by every lint rule and the boundary check, just like a `.ts` file. All required checks pass on Node 22 and Node 24. I wrote this fix, so someone else has to verify it before the finding can close. **What changed** (only the two permitted files, both test-only): - **`apps/api/src/architecture.testkit.ts`:** - `walk()` now picks up files matching `/\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$/` instead of only `.ts`/`.tsx`. - A `*.test.` file counts as a test for all eight extensions. - The header now describes the file scope. - **`apps/api/src/architecture.test.ts`:** five new self-check cases. - One plants `zz-planted.mts`, and the lint now gives exactly the two expected violations: the `node:crypto` namespace import and the deep `../access/policy.ts` import. - Two other cases use a temporary directory, so nothing is written into the real module tree. **One change beyond the strict wording:** the lint now parses `.tsx`/`.jsx` files as JSX; it used to parse everything as plain TypeScript. Once `.jsx` files were in scope, I found a real miss. In a `.tsx` file, `
a'b {require("node:vm")}
` gave 0 violations, because the apostrophe was read as the start of a string and hid the `require`. It's now flagged, and I recorded the failure from before this change. `.ts` files are parsed exactly as before. I included it because scanning `.jsx` files with the wrong parser would only half-close the hole. Reviewers may want to judge it as a separate item. **Checks run:** - **Before the fix:** 3 of the new cases failed (124 of 127 passed). `walk()` returned only the `.ts` and `.tsx` plants and skipped the other six. - **After the fix:** `pnpm vitest run apps/api/src/architecture.test.ts` passes 127/127 on both Node 22.22.2 and Node 24.21.0, and the real module tree still has zero violations. - `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm lint` and `pnpm exec prettier --check` on the two files all exit 0. - `pnpm test` passes on both runtimes: 21 files, 320 tests. - `find apps/api/src/modules -type f ! -name '*.ts' ! -name '*.tsx'` prints nothing, so the fix changes nothing for the current code. **Not my change:** `docs/delivery/findings.json` was modified at 16:22:41Z while I was working (F-DG1-216 moved to FIXED_PENDING_VERIFICATION, presumably by you). I left it alone. There are no migrations or API endpoints, and nothing is committed. The handback, with the full diff and the real test output, is at `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG1/round-13/T-DG1-BE14-backend-workflow-engineer.md`.
